job.job_description:
Greetings from Empower Integrated Solutions (P) Ltd.




Job Title: AI Engineer / GenAI Engineer




We are looking for an AI Engineer / GenAI Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Agentic AI, LLM-based applications, Python, AWS AI/ML services, and data engineering. The candidate should be capable of designing, developing, integrating, and deploying AI-powered solutions in a production environment.




Key Responsibilities:



Design and develop Agentic AI solutions, AI agents, multi-step workflows, and tool/function calling.
Build LLM-based applications using OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or similar platforms.
Develop RAG, knowledge-based AI solutions, prompt engineering, embeddings, and vector search.
Work extensively with AWS AI/ML services, particularly:
AWS Bedrock
Amazon Textract / OCR
Amazon SageMaker
Amazon Comprehend and other relevant AI services
Develop AI/ML backend services and integrations using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI/Flask.
Design and maintain ETL/data pipelines for AI and business applications.
Work with databases including DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, and other relational/NoSQL databases.
Integrate structured and unstructured data into AI pipelines and knowledge systems.
Build and maintain REST APIs and microservices supporting AI solutions.
Implement CI/CD pipelines using Git/Bitbucket, Docker, and cloud deployment practices.
Work with AWS services such as Lambda, S3, SQS, SNS, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and other supporting services.
Implement monitoring, logging, security, scalability, and performance optimization for AI applications.
Collaborate with engineering and business teams to convert use cases into scalable AI solutions.



Required Skills:



Strong hands-on Python development experience.
Practical experience with Generative AI and LLMs.
Strong understanding and hands-on experience with Agentic AI / AI Agent development.
Experience with AWS Bedrock and other AWS AI/ML services.
Experience with OCR / document processing, preferably Amazon Textract.
Experience building RAG and LLM-powered applications.
Good knowledge of DynamoDB and PostgreSQL.
Experience with ETL/data pipelines and data processing.
Experience with Git/Bitbucket and CI/CD pipelines.
Good understanding of REST APIs, microservices, Docker, and cloud-based application deployment.
Strong problem-solving and software engineering skills.



Good to Have



Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar frameworks.
Experience with vector databases such as pgvector, Pinecone, OpenSearch, Qdrant, or similar.
Experience with AWS Lambda, S3, SQS, Step Functions, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, and CloudWatch.
Exposure to Machine Learning / ML model integration.
Experience with AI evaluation, observability, security, and cost optimization.



COMPANY BACKGROUND




Empower Integrated Solutions is a software services company with over 20 years of experience delivering high-quality, custom-built technology platforms. We work with clients across domains and geographies to build scalable, reliable, and secure software solutions that solve real business problems. Our focus is on clean code, sustainable architecture, and long-term partnerships.




So kindly mail your resume to careers@empower-solutions.com
